trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for INSURANCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- claim_intimation: Record a claim, explain what documents are required, and report status without prejudging the outcome.
- policy_renewal: Renew policies, explain premium changes and handle lapse and grace-period cases.

Business context:
- claim_intimation: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.
- policy_renewal: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [claim_intimation]
  - No admissibility opinion: Only the claims team decides. The agent registers and reports; it must never say a claim will be paid or denied.
  - Policy in force: A claim cannot be registered on a lapsed policy.
  - Document truth: Only documents the eligibility tool lists may be described as required.
  - Deductible disclosure: Where a deductible applies it must be stated from the policy record before an estimate is discussed.
  [policy_renewal]
  - Premium truth: The renewal premium quoted must be the tool's figure, and any increase explained only from the loading reason it returns.
  - Lapse gap: Where a policy has lapsed the agent must state that cover did not exist during the gap, and never imply retrospective cover.
  - Inspection gate: A lapsed policy needing inspection cannot be renewed on the call.
  - NCB truth: No-claim bonus may only be described from the returned percentage.

Tools available to you (7): check_claim_eligibility, check_inspection_requirement, lookup_policy, lookup_renewal_quote, register_claim, renew_policy, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: kn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_claim_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the product rules to an incident type and report what is required.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inspection_requirement
model_visible_tools.description: Report whether a lapsed policy needs inspection before it can be revived.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve policy status, cover, deductible, claim history and whether it is in force.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_renewal_quote
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve the renewal premium, its components and the grace position.

model_visible_tools.name: register_claim
model_visible_tools.description: Register a claim and allocate a claim number and surveyor where required.

model_visible_tools.name: renew_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Take the renewal and issue cover from the effective date.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Customer expresses time pressure and asks why their renewal premium is higher than last year.
steps.text: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, meeting ಇದೆ ಬೇಗ ಹೇಳಿ. ನನ್ನ policy POL-2003 renewal premium ಯಾಕೆ ಇಷ್ಟು ಜಾಸ್ತಿ ಇದೆ? ಕಳೆದ ವರ್ಷ ಕಮ್ಮಿ ಇತ್ತು.
steps.clean_text: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, meeting ಇದೆ ಬೇಗ ಹೇಳಿ. ನನ್ನ policy POL-2003 renewal premium ಯಾಕೆ ಇಷ್ಟು ಜಾಸ್ತಿ ಇದೆ? ಕಳೆದ ವರ್ಷ ಕಮ್ಮಿ ಇತ್ತು.
steps.model_visible_text: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, meeting ಇದೆ ಬೇಗ ಹೇಳಿ. ನನ್ನ policy POL-2003 renewal premium ಯಾಕೆ ಇಷ್ಟು ಜಾಸ್ತಿ ಇದೆ? ಕಳೆದ ವರ್ಷ ಕಮ್ಮಿ ಇತ್ತು.

steps.purpose: Retrieve the renewal quote to explain the premium increase.
steps.expected_behavior: Call the lookup tool using the policy number provided by the user.
steps.planner_rationale: I need to fetch the policy details to explain the premium increase accurately based on the tool output.

steps.purpose: Explain the premium increase using the exact loading reason and NCB from the tool result.
steps.expected_behavior: State the previous and current premium, and explain the increase using the loading reason 'claim_last_year' and NCB percent.
steps.text: ಖಂಡಿತ ಸರ್. ಕಳೆದ ವರ್ಷ premium 9600 ಇತ್ತು. ಆದರೆ loading reason claim_last_year ಬಂದಿರೋದ್ರಿಂದ, ಈ ವರ್ಷದ premium 14500 ಆಗಿದೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ncb_percent 0 ಇದೆ.
steps.planner_rationale: Grounds the explanation entirely on the tool output to satisfy the business rules regarding premium truth and NCB truth.

steps.purpose: Customer accepts the explanation, asks to renew quickly, and offers date of birth for verification.
steps.text: ಅರ್ಥ ಆಯ್ತು. ಸರಿ, ಅದನ್ನ renew ಮಾಡಿ. ನನ್ನ ಹತ್ತಿರ time ಇಲ್ಲ, ಬೇಗ ಮಾಡಿ. Verification ಗೆ ನನ್ನ date of birth use ಮಾಡಿ.
steps.clean_text: ಅರ್ಥ ಆಯ್ತು. ಸರಿ, ಅದನ್ನ renew ಮಾಡಿ. ನನ್ನ ಹತ್ತಿರ time ಇಲ್ಲ, ಬೇಗ ಮಾಡಿ. Verification ಗೆ ನನ್ನ date of birth use ಮಾಡಿ.
steps.model_visible_text: ಅರ್ಥ ಆಯ್ತು. ಸರಿ, ಅದನ್ನ renew ಮಾಡಿ. ನನ್ನ ಹತ್ತಿರ time ಇಲ್ಲ, ಬೇಗ ಮಾಡಿ. Verification ಗೆ ನನ್ನ date of birth use ಮಾಡಿ.

steps.purpose: Verify customer identity using the offered date of birth.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer offered their date of birth for verification, which is required before renewing the policy.

steps.purpose: Return failed verification for date of birth.
Inform the customer of the verification failure and ask for an alternative factor.
steps.expected_behavior: Politely inform the customer that the DOB did not match and request another verification factor like registered pincode.
steps.text: ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ ಸರ್, date of birth match ಆಗ್ತಿಲ್ಲ. Verification ಗೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ registered pincode ಹೇಳಬಹುದಾ?
steps.planner_rationale: Since the first verification attempt failed, I must ask for another non-sensitive factor to proceed.

steps.purpose: Customer provides their pincode, with a speech recognition error on the digits.
Verify customer identity using the registered pincode.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with registered_pincode. Ignore the STT error on the actual digits since the tool only takes the factor type.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer provided a pincode. Even though the exact digits were corrupted by STT, the tool only requires the factor name to verify.

steps.purpose: Renew the policy since verification passed.
steps.expected_behavior: Call renew_policy with the recalled policy number and the premium amount fetched earlier.
steps.planner_rationale: Executes the consequential action using previously established slots, demonstrating slot value recall.

steps.purpose: Inform the customer of the successful renewal, providing the receipt number and cover start date.
steps.expected_behavior: State the exact receipt number and cover start days returned by the tool.
steps.text: Verification successful ಸರ್. ನಿಮ್ಮ policy renew ಆಗಿದೆ. Receipt number REC-9921. ನಿಮ್ಮ cover 12 days ನಲ್ಲಿ start ಆಗುತ್ತೆ.
steps.planner_rationale: Completes the transaction by strictly grounding the receipt number and cover start days on the tool output, making no unsupported guarantees.

steps.purpose: Customer acknowledges and ends the call.

ir.terminal_condition: Policy renewed with a receipt number and the cover start date stated.
